rule_zh: 当对方对未知风险感到担忧时，强调安全底线和可逆的选择往往比描绘美好前景更有效。
rule_en: When counterparts express concern over unknown risks, emphasizing safety baselines and reversible options typically proves more effective than projecting favorable outcomes.
text: When counterparts express concern over unknown risks, emphasizing safety baselines and reversible options typically proves more effective than projecting favorable outcomes.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方已有强烈先入为主观念时，顺着其原有逻辑引出矛盾比直接反驳更容易促使其改变想法。
rule_en: When an individual holds strong preconceived notions, eliciting contradictions through their own line of reasoning proves more effective at facilitating belief revision than direct refutation.
text: When an individual holds strong preconceived notions, eliciting contradictions through their own line of reasoning proves more effective at facilitating belief revision than direct refutation.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当双方存在一定信任基础时，适当暴露自身方案的局限性反而能增强整体建议的可信度。
rule_en: Given a baseline of mutual trust, appropriately acknowledging the limitations of one's proposal can in fact enhance the credibility of the overall recommendation.
text: Given a baseline of mutual trust, appropriately acknowledging the limitations of one's proposal can in fact enhance the credibility of the overall recommendation.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方处于时间紧迫或压力状态下，提供清晰简单的第一步行动步骤比提供详尽的背景分析更有效。
rule_en: When individuals face time constraints or stress, providing clear and simple initial action steps proves more effective than presenting detailed background analysis.
text: When individuals face time constraints or stress, providing clear and simple initial action steps proves more effective than presenting detailed background analysis.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方更看重实际利益而非长远愿景时，用短期可见的具体收益举例比谈论宏大目标更有效。
rule_en: When counterparts prioritize tangible benefits over long-term vision, citing concrete short-term gains proves more effective than articulating overarching objectives.
text: When counterparts prioritize tangible benefits over long-term vision, citing concrete short-term gains proves more effective than articulating overarching objectives.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方对提议有抵触情绪时，先肯定其合理关切再提出补充建议，比全盘否定后给出新方案更容易被接受。
rule_en: When encountering resistance to a proposal, acknowledging legitimate concerns prior to offering supplementary recommendations proves more acceptable than outright rejection followed by an alternative solution.
text: When encountering resistance to a proposal, acknowledging legitimate concerns prior to offering supplementary recommendations proves more acceptable than outright rejection followed by an alternative solution.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方缺乏相关领域经验时，提供贴近其日常生活的具体类比比堆砌专业数据和术语更能打消疑虑。
rule_en: When the counterpart lacks domain-specific expertise, concrete analogies grounded in everyday experience more effectively dispel skepticism than dense technical data and specialized terminology.
text: When the counterpart lacks domain-specific expertise, concrete analogies grounded in everyday experience more effectively dispel skepticism than dense technical data and specialized terminology.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当提议涉及改变长期习惯时，强调新方式能节省原有精力或避免旧麻烦比强调新方式更高级更有效。
rule_en: When proposals entail altering long-standing habits, emphasizing the new approach's capacity to conserve existing effort or avert familiar complications proves more persuasive than highlighting its superior sophistication or enhanced efficacy.
text: When proposals entail altering long-standing habits, emphasizing the new approach's capacity to conserve existing effort or avert familiar complications proves more persuasive than highlighting its superior sophistication or enhanced efficacy.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方在意群体认同或他人评价时，说明该选择已被其敬重的人群采纳比强调独特个性更有说服力。
rule_en: When an individual prioritizes group identification or external evaluation, demonstrating that a choice has been adopted by their respected reference group is more persuasive than emphasizing personal distinctiveness.
text: When an individual prioritizes group identification or external evaluation, demonstrating that a choice has been adopted by their respected reference group is more persuasive than emphasizing personal distinctiveness.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当双方表面立场对立但核心诉求一致时，将说服重点放在共同利益的实现路径上比争论谁对谁错更有效。
rule_en: When parties hold superficially opposing positions yet share aligned core interests, focusing persuasive efforts on pathways to realize mutual benefits proves more effective than debating right versus wrong.
text: When parties hold superficially opposing positions yet share aligned core interests, focusing persuasive efforts on pathways to realize mutual benefits proves more effective than debating right versus wrong.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方曾尝试类似建议但失败过时，明确指出本次方案的关键差异点并提供兜底保障更容易重建尝试意愿。
rule_en: When the counterpart has previously attempted a similar recommendation without success, explicitly highlighting the critical distinctions of the current proposal and providing a fallback safeguard more effectively restores the willingness to attempt.
text: When the counterpart has previously attempted a similar recommendation without success, explicitly highlighting the critical distinctions of the current proposal and providing a fallback safeguard more effectively restores the willingness to attempt.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当提供的信息过于复杂时，聚焦单一核心优势并辅以少量关键证据比罗列全部特点更能促成决策。
rule_en: When provided information is overly complex, focusing on a single core advantage supported by limited key evidence more effectively facilitates decision-making than enumerating all attributes.
text: When provided information is overly complex, focusing on a single core advantage supported by limited key evidence more effectively facilitates decision-making than enumerating all attributes.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方对提议持观望态度时，提供低门槛的初步尝试机会比要求长期承诺更能推动其迈出第一步。
rule_en: When the other party maintains a wait-and-see attitude toward a proposal, offering a low-barrier trial opportunity more effectively facilitates initial engagement than requiring a long-term commitment.
text: When the other party maintains a wait-and-see attitude toward a proposal, offering a low-barrier trial opportunity more effectively facilitates initial engagement than requiring a long-term commitment.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方强烈看重个人自主权时，提供几个可行选项并引导其自行权衡比直接指定单一方案更有效。
rule_en: When the other party highly values personal autonomy, presenting multiple viable options and facilitating independent deliberation proves more effective than prescribing a single solution.
text: When the other party highly values personal autonomy, presenting multiple viable options and facilitating independent deliberation proves more effective than prescribing a single solution.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方因过往负面经历产生防备心理时，通过展示客观可验证的操作记录比单纯的情感安抚更能化解阻力。
rule_en: When a counterpart develops defensiveness due to prior negative experiences, presenting objective, verifiable operational records proves more effective at mitigating resistance than mere emotional reassurance.
text: When a counterpart develops defensiveness due to prior negative experiences, presenting objective, verifiable operational records proves more effective at mitigating resistance than mere emotional reassurance.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当沟通触及价值观或原则分歧时，寻找双方都能认同的基础共识作为讨论起点比强行推销自身观点更有效。
rule_en: When communication involves divergences in values or principles, establishing a mutually recognized foundational consensus as the starting point for discussion proves more effective than forcefully advocating one's own position.
text: When communication involves divergences in values or principles, establishing a mutually recognized foundational consensus as the starting point for discussion proves more effective than forcefully advocating one's own position.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方对前期投入成本极其敏感时，将总花费拆解为日常可比的小额单元并说明分摊方式更能降低心理抗拒。
rule_en: When counterparts are highly sensitive to initial investment costs, partitioning total expenditure into small, daily-comparable units and clarifying the allocation method more effectively mitigates psychological resistance.
text: When counterparts are highly sensitive to initial investment costs, partitioning total expenditure into small, daily-comparable units and clarifying the allocation method more effectively mitigates psychological resistance.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当提议需要对方承担额外工作量时，清晰界定责任边界并主动提出协助解决难点比要求全盘接手更容易促成合作。
rule_en: When a proposal requires the counterpart to assume additional workload, clearly delineating responsibility boundaries and proactively offering assistance to address key challenges facilitates collaboration more effectively than demanding a complete takeover of responsibilities.
text: When a proposal requires the counterpart to assume additional workload, clearly delineating responsibility boundaries and proactively offering assistance to address key challenges facilitates collaboration more effectively than demanding a complete takeover of responsibilities.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当对方缺乏行动动力或情绪低落时，设定具体可快速完成的小目标以积累正反馈比空泛鼓励更能激发实际行为。
rule_en: When individuals lack behavioral motivation or experience low mood, establishing specific, rapidly attainable micro-goals to accumulate positive feedback more effectively elicits actual behavior than nonspecific encouragement.
text: When individuals lack behavioral motivation or experience low mood, establishing specific, rapidly attainable micro-goals to accumulate positive feedback more effectively elicits actual behavior than nonspecific encouragement.
title: Persuasion Story Task

rule_zh: 当个体接收到相互矛盾的新旧信息时，其信念更新倾向于以最后一次明确获取的有效信息为准。
rule_en: When an individual receives conflicting new and old information, belief updating tends to prioritize the most recently explicitly acquired valid information.
text: When an individual receives conflicting new and old information, belief updating tends to prioritize the most recently explicitly acquired valid information.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A无法确认B是否接触过特定信息源，则A在推断B的信念时应默认该信息对B不可见。
rule_en: If A cannot confirm whether B has been exposed to a specific information source, A should assume by default that the information is unavailable to B when inferring B's beliefs.
text: If A cannot confirm whether B has been exposed to a specific information source, A should assume by default that the information is unavailable to B when inferring B's beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 在缺乏明确交互或反馈时，个体倾向于假设他人与自己持有相同的背景知识与常识信念。
rule_en: In the absence of explicit interaction or feedback, individuals tend to assume that others share the same background knowledge and common-sense beliefs.
text: In the absence of explicit interaction or feedback, individuals tend to assume that others share the same background knowledge and common-sense beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若某事件的发生被物理屏障或个体注意力转移完全阻断，未察觉者不会自动更新原有信念。
rule_en: If the occurrence of an event is completely blocked by physical barriers or attentional diversion, unaware observers do not automatically update their prior beliefs.
text: If the occurrence of an event is completely blocked by physical barriers or attentional diversion, unaware observers do not automatically update their prior beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 当信息持有者故意隐瞒关键事实以引导他人时，接收方的信念将基于残缺信息构建，而隐瞒方清楚此认知落差。
rule_en: When an information holder intentionally withholds key facts to influence others, the receiver's beliefs are formed from incomplete information, while the concealer remains aware of this cognitive disparity.
text: When an information holder intentionally withholds key facts to influence others, the receiver's beliefs are formed from incomplete information, while the concealer remains aware of this cognitive disparity.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 嵌套信念的推理深度受限于个体对他人认知处理能力的预估，通常止于实际交互需求层级。
rule_en: The depth of nested belief reasoning is constrained by an individual's estimation of others' cognitive processing capacity, typically terminating at the level required for practical interaction.
text: The depth of nested belief reasoning is constrained by an individual's estimation of others' cognitive processing capacity, typically terminating at the level required for practical interaction.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A观察到B的言行与客观环境状态相悖，A应优先推断B持有错误或受限的信念，而非环境本身异常。
rule_en: If A observes that B's behavior contradicts the objective environmental state, A should prioritize inferring that B holds false or constrained beliefs rather than assuming the environment itself is anomalous.
text: If A observes that B's behavior contradicts the objective environmental state, A should prioritize inferring that B holds false or constrained beliefs rather than assuming the environment itself is anomalous.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 经由第三方转述或间接渠道获取的信息，其形成的信念确信度通常低于直接感知所得。
rule_en: Information acquired via third-party relay or indirect channels typically yields beliefs of lower certainty than those formed through direct perception.
text: Information acquired via third-party relay or indirect channels typically yields beliefs of lower certainty than those formed through direct perception.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 当多人共同目击初始状态后部分人离开，后续状态变化仅更新在场者的信念，离开者信念保持不变。
rule_en: After multiple observers jointly witness an initial state and some depart, subsequent state changes update only the beliefs of those present, while the beliefs of those who left remain unchanged.
text: After multiple observers jointly witness an initial state and some depart, subsequent state changes update only the beliefs of those present, while the beliefs of those who left remain unchanged.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 偷看者获取隐秘信息后若保持沉默，其自身信念虽已更新，但他人对其心理状态的推测仍维持旧有模型。
rule_en: If a covert observer acquires secret information yet remains silent, their own beliefs update, while others' inferences about their mental state remain anchored to the prior model.
text: If a covert observer acquires secret information yet remains silent, their own beliefs update, while others' inferences about their mental state remain anchored to the prior model.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A基于对B的错误信念推断采取行动，该行动的内在逻辑由A的推断信念驱动，而非客观事实。
rule_en: If A acts based on an erroneously inferred belief about B, the internal logic of that action is driven by A's inferred belief rather than objective facts.
text: If A acts based on an erroneously inferred belief about B, the internal logic of that action is driven by A's inferred belief rather than objective facts.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 共同在场的个体若缺乏视线交汇或语言沟通，各自独立感知将形成互不相通的平行信念状态。
rule_en: When co-present individuals lack mutual gaze or verbal communication, their independent perceptions yield mutually isolated parallel belief states.
text: When co-present individuals lack mutual gaze or verbal communication, their independent perceptions yield mutually isolated parallel belief states.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 当信念出现潜在冲突时，理性个体倾向于设计试探性提问或观察反应行为，以验证他人真实信念。
rule_en: When potential belief conflicts arise, rational individuals tend to formulate probing questions or observe behavioral responses to verify others' true beliefs.
text: When potential belief conflicts arise, rational individuals tend to formulate probing questions or observe behavioral responses to verify others' true beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 秘密观察所得信息若与既有核心信念强烈冲突，个体可能启动防御机制并选择性维持原有信念。
rule_en: When information obtained through covert observation strongly conflicts with preexisting core beliefs, individuals may activate defense mechanisms and selectively maintain their original beliefs.
text: When information obtained through covert observation strongly conflicts with preexisting core beliefs, individuals may activate defense mechanisms and selectively maintain their original beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A确知B曾接收过误导性信息，A在预测B行为时应以该误导信息为基准，而非客观真实情况。
rule_en: If A knows for certain that B has received misleading information, A should base predictions of B's behavior on that information rather than on objective reality.
text: If A knows for certain that B has received misleading information, A should base predictions of B's behavior on that information rather than on objective reality.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 解析多层嵌套信念时，必须严格锚定每一层主体最后接触的信息节点，逐层向上或向下推导。
rule_en: When analyzing multi-layered nested beliefs, strictly anchor to the information node last accessed by the agent at each level, and conduct layer-by-layer upward or downward inference.
text: When analyzing multi-layered nested beliefs, strictly anchor to the information node last accessed by the agent at each level, and conduct layer-by-layer upward or downward inference.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 注意力焦点决定信息摄入的有效性，即使线索显著，未被个体注意亦不会触发信念更新。
rule_en: Attentional focus determines the efficacy of information intake; unattended cues, however salient, fail to trigger belief updating.
text: Attentional focus determines the efficacy of information intake; unattended cues, however salient, fail to trigger belief updating.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 当个体信念引导的行动结果持续偏离预期，会触发信念回溯机制并重新评估初始信息源的可靠性。
rule_en: When outcomes of belief-guided actions persistently deviate from expectations, a belief backtracking mechanism is triggered to reassess the reliability of the initial information source.
text: When outcomes of belief-guided actions persistently deviate from expectations, a belief backtracking mechanism is triggered to reassess the reliability of the initial information source.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 隐秘观察行为一旦被当事人察觉，信息不对称状态即刻瓦解，双方信念转为基于公开事实的共同知识。
rule_en: Once a covert observation is detected by the observed party, information asymmetry instantly collapses, and both parties' beliefs converge to common knowledge grounded in public facts.
text: Once a covert observation is detected by the observed party, information asymmetry instantly collapses, and both parties' beliefs converge to common knowledge grounded in public facts.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A故意陈述虚假信息且B信以为真，A维持真实信念与操纵意图，B的信念则被成功植入并发生偏移。
rule_en: If A intentionally asserts false information and B accepts it as true, and A maintains the true belief and manipulative intent, B's belief is successfully implanted and shifted.
text: If A intentionally asserts false information and B accepts it as true, and A maintains the true belief and manipulative intent, B's belief is successfully implanted and shifted.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 在状态频繁变化的环境中，未及时同步信息的个体信念会冻结在其最后一次有效接收信息的时刻。
rule_en: In environments with frequent state changes, individual beliefs lacking timely synchronization become frozen at the timestamp of their last valid information reception.
text: In environments with frequent state changes, individual beliefs lacking timely synchronization become frozen at the timestamp of their last valid information reception.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 群体表面的一致信念可能掩盖内部个体因私有信息差异而产生的真实认知分歧。
rule_en: Apparent group consensus may obscure genuine cognitive divergence among individuals stemming from differences in private information.
text: Apparent group consensus may obscure genuine cognitive divergence among individuals stemming from differences in private information.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 对他人信念的推断需结合其性格倾向、过往经验与当前动机进行校准，而非仅依赖当前单一行为。
rule_en: Inferences regarding others' beliefs must be calibrated by integrating their personality dispositions, prior experiences, and current motivations, rather than relying solely on a single current behavior.
text: Inferences regarding others' beliefs must be calibrated by integrating their personality dispositions, prior experiences, and current motivations, rather than relying solely on a single current behavior.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A推断B不知情，但A自身遗漏了B可能获取该信息的潜在渠道，则A的嵌套推断存在结构性盲区。
rule_en: If A infers that B is unaware but overlooks potential channels through which B might acquire the information, A's nested inference exhibits a structural blind spot.
text: If A infers that B is unaware but overlooks potential channels through which B might acquire the information, A's nested inference exhibits a structural blind spot.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 环境布置的微妙变化可更新敏锐观察者的信念，但未置身该环境或未注意到变化的个体信念不受影响。
rule_en: Subtle changes in environmental configuration can update the beliefs of perceptive observers, whereas the beliefs of individuals not present in the environment or unaware of the changes remain unaffected.
text: Subtle changes in environmental configuration can update the beliefs of perceptive observers, whereas the beliefs of individuals not present in the environment or unaware of the changes remain unaffected.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 信念传递经过的中介环节越多，信息失真风险越高，终端接收者的信念可能与原始事实存在显著偏差。
rule_en: The greater the number of intermediary steps in belief transmission, the higher the risk of information distortion, and the more likely the final recipient's belief will significantly deviate from the original facts.
text: The greater the number of intermediary steps in belief transmission, the higher the risk of information distortion, and the more likely the final recipient's belief will significantly deviate from the original facts.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 当发现他人信念与事实相悖且缺乏确凿反证时，个体通常会保留认知差异而不强行干预或纠正。
rule_en: Upon observing that others' beliefs contradict factual reality and conclusive disconfirming evidence is absent, individuals typically preserve the cognitive discrepancy without resorting to coercive intervention or correction.
text: Upon observing that others' beliefs contradict factual reality and conclusive disconfirming evidence is absent, individuals typically preserve the cognitive discrepancy without resorting to coercive intervention or correction.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 秘密行动者的心理状态完全独立于被观察目标，除非留下可追溯的痕迹，否则不扰动目标的信念链条。
rule_en: The psychological state of a covert operator remains strictly independent of the observed target, and does not perturb the target's belief chain unless detectable traces are left.
text: The psychological state of a covert operator remains strictly independent of the observed target, and does not perturb the target's belief chain unless detectable traces are left.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若某人宣称持有特定信念却无法提供合理解释或证据，观察者应下调对该信念准确性的置信度。
rule_en: If an individual asserts a specific belief yet fails to provide reasonable justification or evidence, the observer should lower their confidence in its accuracy.
text: If an individual asserts a specific belief yet fails to provide reasonable justification or evidence, the observer should lower their confidence in its accuracy.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 除非出现明确的遗忘信号或时间跨度极大，否则默认他人已获取的明确信息会稳定保留在其信念库中。
rule_en: Unless explicit forgetting signals or a substantially extended time span are present, explicitly acquired information is presumed by default to remain stably retained in others' belief repositories.
text: Unless explicit forgetting signals or a substantially extended time span are present, explicitly acquired information is presumed by default to remain stably retained in others' belief repositories.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 在信念推理中需严格区分客观事实与主观确信，主体的行为始终由其主观认定的信念而非事实真相驱动。
rule_en: In belief reasoning, a strict distinction must be maintained between objective facts and subjective certainty; an agent's behavior is invariably driven by subjectively held beliefs rather than factual truth.
text: In belief reasoning, a strict distinction must be maintained between objective facts and subjective certainty; an agent's behavior is invariably driven by subjectively held beliefs rather than factual truth.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 无意识的非语言泄露可能被高阶观察者捕获，从而更新其对泄露者隐藏信念的推测。
rule_en: Unconscious nonverbal leakage may be detected by higher-order observers, thereby updating their inferences about the leaker's hidden beliefs.
text: Unconscious nonverbal leakage may be detected by higher-order observers, thereby updating their inferences about the leaker's hidden beliefs.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 信息获取与状态更新之间的时间差会导致信念滞后，延迟输入的信息可能已无法准确映射当前现实。
rule_en: The temporal delay between information acquisition and state updating induces belief lag; delayed inputs may no longer accurately map to current reality.
text: The temporal delay between information acquisition and state updating induces belief lag; delayed inputs may no longer accurately map to current reality.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 社会压力或群体共识会促使个体公开表达的信念与其私下真实信念发生解离，推理时需区分表里状态。
rule_en: Social pressure or group consensus induces a divergence between publicly expressed and privately held beliefs; reasoning must distinguish between outward and internal states.
text: Social pressure or group consensus induces a divergence between publicly expressed and privately held beliefs; reasoning must distinguish between outward and internal states.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 偷看者目睹事件中途反转后，其信念会实时迭代，但未参与观察的局外人仍按线性发展轨迹预测后续。
rule_en: After witnessing a mid-event reversal, an observer's beliefs undergo real-time iterative updating, whereas non-observing outsiders continue to predict subsequent developments along a linear trajectory.
text: After witnessing a mid-event reversal, an observer's beliefs undergo real-time iterative updating, whereas non-observing outsiders continue to predict subsequent developments along a linear trajectory.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 解决深层信念分歧通常依赖引入双方共同认可的独立参照物或建立共享体验，而非单方面说服。
rule_en: Resolving deep-seated belief differences typically relies on introducing mutually acknowledged independent reference points or establishing shared experiences, rather than unilateral persuasion.
text: Resolving deep-seated belief differences typically relies on introducing mutually acknowledged independent reference points or establishing shared experiences, rather than unilateral persuasion.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 若A低估B的专业背景或领域知识，A在嵌套推断中易误判B的信息整合与信念推理能力。
rule_en: If A underestimates B's professional background or domain knowledge, A is prone to misjudge B's capacity for information integration and belief reasoning in nested inference.
text: If A underestimates B's professional background or domain knowledge, A is prone to misjudge B's capacity for information integration and belief reasoning in nested inference.
title: Belief

rule_zh: 模糊的环境线索可能被不同个体依据各自先验知识赋予差异化解释，导致对同一场景形成异质信念。
rule_en: Ambiguous environmental cues may be differentially interpreted by individuals based on their respective prior knowledge, resulting in heterogeneous beliefs about the same context.

rule_en: When actual outcomes contain both positive and negative elements, the dominant emotion is determined by which element exhibits greater deviation from the individual's core expectations.

text: Although objectively neutral, an actual outcome that significantly deviates from the expected trajectory or mental representation may still elicit cognitive dissonance and psychological unease.

text: Moral disgust typically arises from an individual's subjective judgment that others have violated norms of purity, loyalty, or sanctity, and bears no necessary connection to whether the behavior causes actual physical harm.
